title: General Proteomics FASP (Filter-Aided Sample Preparation)
author: Jacob Waldbauer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.if7cbrn
materials: Prepare fresh buffers in LC-MS water: Exchange buffer: 8M urea, 0.2% (w/v) deoxycholate, 1M ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8) Digestion buffer: 0.2% (w/v) deoxycholate, 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8) Trypsin dissolution/peptide recovery buffer: 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8)

steps.title: Load protein onto filter
steps.instruction: Dispense 25–50 µL reduced, alkylated protein extract onto the filter unit, centrifuge at 14,000 g for 10 min, discard filtrate, and repeat this loading‑centrifuge cycle a total of four times.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 25–50 µL reduced, alkylated extract onto filter.
Repeat the above three actions three more times (four loads total).

steps.title: Wash filter with digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL digestion buffer to the filter, spin at 14,000 g for 10 min, and repeat this wash twice in total.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the above two actions once more (two washes total).

steps.title: Add exchange buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Fill the filter unit with 200 µL exchange buffer and mix thoroughly by pipetting.

steps.title: Transfer filter to collection tube
steps.instruction: Move the filter unit into a passivated collection tube.

steps.title: Add trypsin digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Add 110 µL digestion buffer containing trypsin at approximately a 1:50 trypsin‑to‑protein ratio (dissolved in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate), keep the mixture on ice or at 4 °C, seal with parafilm, and incubate at 37 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Prepare digestion buffer with trypsin (~1:50 ratio) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
Add 110 µL of this mixture to the filter.
Keep on ice/4 °C, parafilm the tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge digested sample
steps.instruction: If parafilm was used, remove it, then centrifuge the tube at 14,000 g for 10 min, retaining the filtrate.

steps.title: Recover peptides from filter
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL peptide recovery buffer to the filter and spin at 14,000 g for 10 min; repeat this recovery step twice in total.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the above two actions once more (two recoveries total).

steps.title: Collect peptide solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the combined filtrate to a LoBind tube.

steps.title: Precipitate peptides with ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL ethyl acetate and 2.5 µL TFA to the filtrate, vortex briefly; a precipitate may become visible.

steps.title: Extract peptides by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate the tube in a bath sonicator for 10 seconds, then centrifuge at 16,000 g for 10 min.

steps.title: Remove organic layer
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, carefully aspirate the upper organic (ethyl acetate) layer without disturbing the phase boundary.

substeps.instruction: Pipet off the upper organic layer, avoiding the interface.

steps.title: Repeat ethyl acetate extraction twice
steps.instruction: Perform two additional extraction cycles: add 900 µL ethyl acetate (no TFA), vortex, sonicate 10 s, centrifuge at 16,000 g for 10 min, and remove the organic layer each time.

substeps.instruction: Remove upper organic layer as before.
Repeat the entire cycle once more (total of two extractions).

steps.title: Dry peptide extract
steps.instruction: Place the sample uncovered in a Thermomixer and dry at 60 °C for 5–10 minutes until all ethyl acetate has evaporated.

substeps.instruction: Dry at 60 °C for 5–10 min in Thermomixer.

steps.title: Freeze and lyophilize sample
steps.instruction: Freeze the dried sample solid at –80 °C and then use a Centrivap to remove any remaining solvent to complete dryness.
